operatingPoint.measuredOn: calibration/set4-d1.json: 23 of 24 at 0.600, read through the kernel's own watchAs() over /v1/systemone on d1-2B-Q8_0 — the lowest `act` is 0.740 and the highest of everything else is 0.611. The two classes do not overlap: every `act` sits above every other label, and the cut at 0.600 sits just below the gap, so the one case it reads wrong is an `ignore` that crosses the line by 0.011. The figure is separation, not margin. The same record holds a four-bot matrix: the bot that was named reads 0.91 / 0.96 and the three that were not read 0.26-0.55, and a room that names nobody reads under 0.56 for all four (16 of 16). Both readings need the `others` line: without it the lowest `act` fell to 0.823 and the highest `ignore` rose to 0.810, which is one distribution rather than two.
